turns.content: Why can snapshot isolation still permit write skew?
Each transaction can update a different row after reading the same valid snapshot, so neither detects a direct write-write conflict while the joint invariant breaks.
For two on-call rows, both doctors can observe two active doctors and independently set their own row off call.
